name: Truckee Tahoe Airport

runway.v: two runways, 11/29 7,000 ft x 100 ft (2,134 m x 30 m) and 02/20 4,650 ft x 75 ft

curfew.v: voluntary no-fly curfew 22:00-07:00 local for arrivals and departures (Good Neighbor policy; Fly Quiet asks pilots not to fly then unless using Shoulder Hour Protocols)

ppr.v: runway 11/29 is rated 50,000 lb single wheel and 80,000 lb dual wheel; heavier aircraft need prior permission (runway 02/20: 35,000/50,000 lb)
ppr.quote: Anything over 50/80 on 11/29 needs a PPR (Prior Permission Request)

hours.v: control tower 07:00-18:00 local in winter (1 Oct-14 Mar), 07:00-19:30 spring, 07:00-20:00 summer, 07:00-19:00 fall; FBO services daily 07:00-21:00

noise.v: noise abatement: best-angle climb for the first 500 ft then best rate, avoid residential areas, intersection departures discouraged; runway 2 is the preferred departure runway
noise.quote: Runway 2 is the preferred departure runway for noise abatement.

notes: All rules from the Truckee Tahoe Airport District's own pages (Runway Information/flight planning, Procedures, Fly Quiet; undated). The Procedures page gives summer tower hours as 06/01-09/30 07:00-20:00, while the Runway Information page says 05/01-09/01; the winter hours agree. No customs statement found. FAA diagram AL-6021 surfaced only for old cycles (latest 2607) and was not read; Chart Supplement SW not opened. IATA not stated in an official source read (FAA identifier is TRK).
